project_title: Historical METR-LA Traffic Speed Forecasting (Phase 1 Baseline & Classical ML System)
dataset_name: METR-LA (Los Angeles County Highway Loop Detectors)
benchmark_citation: Li, Y., Yu, R., Shahabi, C., & Liu, Y. (2018). Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network: Data-Driven Traffic Forecasting. International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR 2018).

files.description: Raw speed readings from 207 loop detector stations on Los Angeles County highways sampled at 5-minute intervals between 2012-03-01 00:00:00 and 2012-06-27 23:55:00.
Ordered comma-delimited list of 207 unique California PeMS sensor identification numbers defining canonical graph node sequence.
Pairwise road network shortest-path distances between sensor stations computed along the highway topology in meters.
Geographical latitude and longitude coordinates for all 207 loop detector stations.
Precomputed Gaussian thresholded directed adjacency matrix (207x207) with standard DCRNN normalized kernel k=0.1.
